message:
Subject: PO-4101 delivery moved

Hi, quick update on PO-4101: the factory pushed us back, and the revised delivery date is 2026-11-18. Sorry for the shift — everything else on the order stays the same.

Best,
Marco (Alpine Fasteners)

Subject: FW: PO-4102 — new ETA

Team, forwarding the supplier's note for PO-4102. They confirmed arrival on 2026-12-02, moved from 2026-11-20 due to port congestion. Please update the PO.

Thanks,
Priya

Subject: PO-4103 delayed

Hello, I'm afraid PO-4103 will now arrive on November 25, 2026 instead of November 10. The goods are finished and waiting on a container.

Regards,
Elena

Subject: Re: PO-4104 delivery

Good news and bad news for PO-4104. The new confirmed date is 12 Dec 2026 — two weeks earlier than we feared, though still later than the original 20 Nov. Let me know if that works.

— Sam

Subject: Short shipment on PO-4105

Hi, on PO-4105 we can only ship 60 of the 100 units this month — raw material shortage on our side. The remaining 40 will follow in January, exact date TBC.

Ana

Subject: PO-4106 quantity revision

Please revise PO-4106 down to 25 units. Our line can only complete 25 before the holiday shutdown; we will rebook the balance as a separate order if you still need it.

Regards,
Chen

Subject: PO-4107 ready to ship

We have eight (8) units of PO-4107 packed and leaving our warehouse on 2026-11-20. Tracking will follow tomorrow.

— Warehouse team

Subject: PO-4108 on track

Just confirming PO-4108 is still on track for 2026-12-05. No changes on our side.

— Tomas

Subject: delays

Hi, PO-4109 and PO-4110 are both delayed by about a week. New dates to follow once the carrier confirms. Sorry about this.

— Fatima

Subject: order delayed

Hi, your order placed last month is delayed to mid-December. I will send the exact date as soon as the factory confirms. Thanks for your patience.

Subject: PO-9999 moved

Regarding PO-9999, delivery moved to 2026-12-01. Let me know if you need anything else.

— Rob

Subject: Fwd: PO-4111 dates (please read latest first)

Latest update from supplier, 28 Oct: ignore the quoted ETA 2026-10-01 below — the correct date for PO-4111 is 2026-11-30. The October date was from an old quotation.

--- Forwarded ---
> ETA for PO-4111: 2026-10-01 (per September quote).

Subject: PO-4112 date conflict

PO-4112: our warehouse says 2026-12-03 but the forwarder says 2026-12-10. Waiting on the factory to confirm which one is right — will update you tomorrow.

Subject: PO-4113 shipping soon

Good news — PO-4113 will ship next Friday. Tracking to follow once it leaves.

Subject: PO-4114 confirmed

PO-4114 confirmed for 2026-12-15, 40 units. Thanks!

— Dana

Subject: PO-4114 confirmed

PO-4114 confirmed for 2026-12-15, 40 units. Thanks!

— Dana

Subject: PO-4115 quantity range

For PO-4115 we can do between 45 and 55 units — final count confirmed on Monday after the production run.

Subject: PO-4116 pulled forward

Good news on PO-4116: the line finished early, so delivery is pulled forward to 2026-11-05 from 2026-11-20. Invoice follows separately.

— Greta

Subject: Revised date PO-4117

PO-4117 update: unfortunately we have to push delivery to 2027-01-08. The delay is a customs hold, now cleared, and the goods ship this week.

Regards,
Omar

Subject: PO-4118 new date

Hello — PO-4118 will now be delivered on January 6, 2027. Apologies for the third change; the component shortage is finally resolved.

— Ingrid

Subject: Partial shipment PO-4119

PO-4119: 15 units ship today, tracking 1Z8845. The balance of 25 follows on 2026-12-18 barring weather delays.

— Logistics

Subject: PO-4120 reduced

We have to reduce PO-4120 to 12 units — the rest of the batch failed inspection. A credit note for the shortfall is attached.

— Quality team

Subject: PO-4121 dispatch

Twelve (12) cartons for PO-4121 leave Rotterdam on 2026-11-28. Documents attached.

— Export desk

Subject: Re: PO-4122

Still expecting PO-4122 on Dec 20, 2026. Will flag immediately if anything changes.

— Yusuf

Subject: several orders delayed

PO-4123, PO-4124 and PO-4125 are all held at the port. Expect one consolidated update with new dates tomorrow morning.

Subject: valves order

The valves order is running about two weeks late because of a coating issue. New date early January — confirming exact day Friday.

Subject: PO-41O1 delivery

PO-41O1 delivery is set for 2026-12-09. Please confirm receipt of this message.

Subject: Fwd: PO-4126 quantity correction

Correction to my earlier note: the confirmed quantity for PO-4126 is 18 units, not 30. The 30 figure included another customer's allocation by mistake. Date unchanged at 2026-12-08.

— Beatriz

Subject: PO-4127 quantity mismatch

PO-4127: the email body says 20 units but the attached order confirmation says 25. Please advise which is correct before we load the truck.

Subject: PO-4128 packing list

Attached is the final packing list for PO-4128 with the per-carton breakdown. Let me know if customs needs anything else.

Subject: Happy holidays

Our office is closed Dec 24 through Jan 2. Wishing you a restful break!

— The team at Brunner & Sohn

Subject: PO-4129 cancelled

PO-4129 for 40 units due 2026-12-20 is cancelled; replacement date pending. The deposit will be credited to your next order.

— Accounts
